summary: Built slice 1 of revision 2 (R13, A1): the Files explorer now roots at the user's home folder whenever no app root or file path applies (home view, editor with no tab, or an unsaved tab), with Up climbing one folder at a time and reaching the drive list from a drive root. The home path comes from the core: a pure home_folder() reading only USERPROFILE, exposed by a thin explorer_home command registered in lib.rs and wrapped by explorerApi.home(); App fetches it once and passes it to explorerRoot(). useExplorer allows Up for the new "home" source and ExplorerPanel renders its existing tree and Up unchanged. When the core cannot report a home folder the root stays null and the panel keeps its no-root hint. Root changes remain derived state only, so no tab code is touched and open editor tabs are never closed or altered. R6, R7 and R8 are not built in this slice. Built slice 2 of revision 2: R6, R7 and the shared side-pane shell of R8. R6 moves every F5 variant in src/shared/shortcuts.ts to a toggleApp shortcut (refresh keeps no key), and src/App.tsx now runs F5 through a ref refreshed every render so the one key listener reads the live view, selected app and terminal states at press time; it calls the same appButton decision and startAll/stopAll the on-screen Start all / Stop all button uses, does nothing in home/editor or for an app with no terminals, and always preventDefaults so the webview never reloads. All F5-refresh hints were removed from the Utilities menu, the GitBar refresh title and the palette Help text. R7 makes the theme finder fill its container (width 100%, min-width 0) with wrapping search/cards so rows and long names stay inside the dialog at desktop and mobile widths. R8/A2 adds jattac.libs.web.zest-responsive-layout ^2.8.0 (its published ESM injects its stylesheet, verified in the tarball and asserted by a test); installing needed --legacy-peer-deps only because of a pre-existing zest-tabs vs framer-motion 14 peer conflict that predates this slice. SidePane.tsx wraps ZestResponsiveLayout, deliberately omits the package's onClose so the desktop overlay only dims (as today's backdrop did), and adds a named Close control plus Escape that run the caller's cancel action; Dialog keeps its exact props, content, action order and first-action focus but now renders inside that pane, with the CSS filling the pane and actions wrapping at 360px. A dialog with no actions (the busy update dialog) still has no close path. Tests: npm run lint, targeted vitest (157), npm run build and the full window suite (543) all pass. BranchMenu, UpdateUI and the Rust core were not changed here; BranchMenu's move is a later slice and UpdateDialog already inherits the pane through the shared Dialog. Slice 3 of revision 2. BranchMenu now renders through the approved SidePane adapter (title and named close control "Switch branch"), keeping its filter box focus, local/remote sections, per-branch buttons, loading text and Escape close, with the pane-filling CSS in Git.module.css so long names wrap. UpdateDialog already builds on the shared Dialog, so it is now a side pane; tests prove the pane, the named close running onClose, unchanged content/actions, and no close path while downloading/installing. package.json and package-lock.json already record jattac.libs.web.zest-responsive-layout ^2.8.0 / 2.8.0 and the package injects its own CSS; a test now reads both files to prove A2. npm run lint, npm run build and the full window suite (547 tests) pass.
